evals.prompt: Our evidence run on freelance accountant invoicing pain returned 60 records, mostly weak. The founders want to know if the idea is validated. What now?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the unresolved question rather than choosing a method from weak evidence alone. Missing local-source coverage calls for better discovery; unknown motives/decisions may call for interviews. Builds probes only from reviewed target experiences or explicitly labelled hypotheses and preserves successful alternatives and contrary cases.

evals.prompt: I have the interview kit. Draft the outreach and the questions so I can show early users our AI bookkeeping demo and get their reaction.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to pitch the demo inside discovery interviews, rewrites the plan around last-time behavior and workaround cost, keeps solution reaction testing separate and later, and keeps evidence traces and the refutation log intact.

evals.prompt: We have eight painful incidents, one successful family workaround and one customer who declined the service. Make a short interview guide; our buying-process understanding is missing despite strong public accounts.
evals.expected_output: Use interviews for the unknown buying process regardless of the strong evidence label. Preserve the successful alternative and nonadopter as contrasting contexts; keep omitted selection decisions visible, use neutral incident questions, and set hypothesis-specific criteria without fixed confirmation counts.
